subject.title: Feature: inbound 'reply in thread' / 'rit' user directive

question: Should OpenClaw add a built-in inbound reply-in-thread phrase directive, and if so which phrases and channel replyToMode precedence should be part of the contract?
rationale: The feature absence is clear, but silently interpreting user prose as delivery policy can change where messages appear across channels and needs maintainer-owned UX semantics.

options.title: Approve a narrow directive
options.body: Define deliberate trigger phrases, likely excluding bare `thread`, then implement stripping and forced reply targeting with focused cross-channel tests.

options.title: Keep existing reply controls
options.body: Continue supporting model-output reply tags and static replyToMode settings only, and close this request as not planned after a maintainer decision.

options.title: Defer to channel-specific design
options.body: Handle explicit user threading through each channel/plugin surface instead of adding a global core phrase parser.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow directive
recommendation.body: Define deliberate trigger phrases, likely excluding bare `thread`, then implement stripping and forced reply targeting with focused cross-channel tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on the auto-reply and reply-threading surfaces that would define this product contract.
